Disclosure  to  Promote  the  Right  To  Information 

Whereas  the  Parliament  of  India  has  set  out  to  provide  a  practical  regime  of  right  to 
information  for  citizens  to  secure  access  to  information  under  the  control  of  public  authorities, 
in  order  to  promote  transparency  and  accountability  in  the  working  of  every  public  authority, 
and  whereas  the  attached  publication  of  the  Bureau  of  Indian  Standards  is  of  particular  interest 
to  the  public,  particularly  disadvantaged  communities  and  those  engaged  in  the  pursuit  of 
education  and  knowledge,  the  attached  public  safety  standard  is  made  available  to  promote  the 
timely  dissemination  of  this  information  in  an  accurate  manner  to  the  public. 


Mazdoor  Kisan  Shakti  Sangathan 
"The  Right  to  Information,  The  Right  to  Live''

Indian  Standard 

SPECIFICATION  FOR 

KITCHEN  KNIFE  TERMINAL  DEVICE 

FOR  ARTIFICIAL  LIMBS 


1.  Scope  —  Specifies  dimensional  and  other  requirements  for  kitchen  knife  terminal  device  for  artificial 
limbs  used  by  amputees  of  upper  limb. 

2.  Shape  and  Dimensions  —  As  shown  in  Fig.  1. 


All  dimensions  In  millinfietres. 
FIG.  1     KITCHEN  KNIFE,  TERMINAL  DEVICE,  TYPICAL 

2.1  The  device  maybe  made  in  one  piece  or  as  composite  construction  in  two  pieces. 

2.2  The  shapes   and   sizes    of   the   knife  may  vary    as   agreed   to   between   the   purchasar   and   the 
supplier  except  that  of  interchangeable  dimensions  of  screw  thread. 

3.  IVIaterial  —  High  carbon  steel  conforming  to  Designation   C  55  of   18:1875-1978  'Specification  for 
carbon  steel  billets,  blooms,  slabs  and  bars  for  forgings  ( fourth  revision  )'. 

4.  Workmanship  and  Finish 

4.1  All   surfaces  shall   be   finished   smooth.     The   knife  edge  shall   be  ground  sharp,   and  free  from 
burrs,  projection,  etc. 

4.2  When  made  as  composite  construction,  welded  or  brazed  joints  shall  be  dressed  smooth. 

4.3  The  complete  assembly  after  finishing  shall  be  oiled  or  greased  for  antirust  coating. 

4.4  If   plating   is  done  it  shall   be   according   to  service  grade  3   of   IS :  1068-1968   'Specification  for 
electroplated  coatings  of  nickel  and  chromium  on  iron  and  steel  ( first  revision  )'. 

5.  IMarl^Ing  —  The  device   shall   be    marked  with    the    manufacturer's   name,    initial   or   recognized 
trade-mark. 

5.1  ISI  Cartiflcatlon  Marking  —  Details  available  with  the  Indian  Standards  Institution. 

6.  Packing 

6.1  The  device  shall  be  wrapped  in  polyethylene  bag  individually.     The  overall  packing  for  multiple 
numbers  may  be  as  agreed  to  between  the  purchaser  and  the  supplier. 


Adopted  18  March  1983 


O  August  1983,  ISt 


INDIAN    STANDARDS    INSTITUTION
